name: linked-draw-extension
author: Robert Koval
description: A local-first WebExtension for drawing directly on a LinkedIn profile cover and handing the generated image to LinkedIn's native upload flow.

scripts.check: npm run syntax && npm run shell && npm test && npm run verify
scripts.compat:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@10.6.0 lint --source-dir dist/firefox --no-input --warnings-as-errors
scripts.package: npm run check && npm run package:browsers
scripts.release: npm run clean && npm run check && npm run package:browsers && npm run package:source
